description: Persist exact optional seat choices on the owner's Gondola checkout draft using selection tokens returned by get_flight_seats. This does not reserve a supplier seat, book a flight, authenticate a card or charge the traveler. Use recorded stated/learned preferences and supported history to preselect a matching available seat; a paid preferred seat may be preselected for checkout review, but show its price and disclosures. Send all desired tokens, or [] for no preference. The resulting current quote and checkout link retain the choices across reloads and clear earlier price/consent readiness. The traveler must check the final all-in Card price and explicitly approve purchase in checkout. Stale or unavailable choices require fresh availability; do not silently replace a seat or increase the price. Nothing here authorizes post-booking seat changes.

quote_id.description: Exact current quote UUID returned with these seat choices.

seat_selection_tokens.description: At most 36 unchanged selection tokens from get_flight_seats. An empty array clears the choices; runtime validation enforces token and count limits.

test.description: Use supplier test inventory; approved self-account OAuth only. Listed accounts default to test mode.

name: select_flight_seats
